title: Experience Memory Graph: Extracting Reusable Correction Knowledge from Agent Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2607.13884v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown remarkable capabilities in autonomous decision-making by generating sequential trajectories of states, actions, and observations. However, in complex, long-horizon tasks, these agents frequently suffer from compounding errors and struggle to recover from failures. Despite advances in experience memory, extracting reliable and transferable correction knowledge from historical trajectories remains challenging. Existing methods, whether based on test-time reflection or offline memory construction, largely rely on LLMs to diagnose failures and formulate corrective strategies, which can produce brittle or task-specific insights that are difficult to generalize. To address this challenge, we propose Experience Memory Graph (EMG), a framework that reformulates agent failure recovery as a graph matching problem. translated_title: 经验记忆图：从智能体轨迹中提取可复用的纠错知识
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过生成由状态、动作和观察组成的序列轨迹，在自主决策方面展现出卓越的能力。然而，在复杂的长期任务中，这些智能体经常受到累积误差的影响，难以从失败中恢复。尽管经验记忆技术已有进展，但从历史轨迹中提取可靠且可迁移的纠错知识仍然具有挑战性。现有方法，无论是基于测试时反思还是离线记忆构建，大多依赖LLM来诊断失败并制定纠正策略，这可能产生脆弱的或局限于特定任务的见解，难以泛化。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了经验记忆图（EMG），这是一个将智能体失败恢复重新表述为图匹配问题的框架。在训练集上进行离线构建时，我们将失败的探索轨迹……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出经验记忆图（EMG）框架，将智能体的失败恢复重新表述为图匹配问题，从而从历史轨迹中提取可靠、可迁移且可复用的纠错知识。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Experience Memory Graph (EMG), a framework that reformulates agent failure recovery as a graph matching problem to extract reliable, transferable, and reusable correction knowledge from historical agent trajectories.
